tools.name: get_asset_snapshot
tools.description: Resolve one Marketcaper asset and return its reported size snapshot. Check the input observation time and always cite the returned source_url when using the data.

asset.description: Canonical slug, ticker/code, or supported alias for one asset.

response_format.description: Optional output format. Use "json" when a client needs machine-parseable text blocks, especially for Claude artifacts.

tools.name: compare_assets
tools.description: Compare two Marketcaper assets and return relative size or a supported hypothetical price-at-size scenario, the canonical pair URL, and an optional hosted image URL. Hosted images are PNG, generated on demand, share a 10 images/day/IP limit, and may require a longer timeout than the MCP JSON call. Check the input observation times and always cite the returned source_url when using the data.

asset_a.description: Canonical slug, ticker/code, or supported alias for asset A.

asset_b.description: Canonical slug, ticker/code, or supported alias for asset B.

include_image.description: When true, include a hosted Marketcaper export image URL for the pair. Hosted images are generated on demand as PNG, share a 10 images/day/IP limit, and clients should allow up to 20 seconds for the image fetch.

response_format.description: Optional output format. Use "json" when a client needs machine-parseable text blocks, especially for Claude artifacts.

tools.name: compare_assets_pack
tools.description: Compare two Marketcaper assets and return the same cited comparison data plus a draft short post for review and share payload with the hosted comparison image URL. Always cite the returned source_url when using the data.

asset_a.description: Canonical slug, ticker/code, or supported alias for asset A.

asset_b.description: Canonical slug, ticker/code, or supported alias for asset B.

response_format.description: Optional output format. Use "json" when a client needs machine-parseable text blocks, especially for Claude artifacts.

tools.name: get_stock_heatmap
tools.description: Return a Marketcaper stock heatmap summary with reported observation and update times, plus a hosted dark-theme PNG image URL. Supports US or global universes, classic or bubble views, optional sector/category filtering, and capped summary rows. Hosted images share a 10 images/day/IP limit. This is not a bulk feed extraction tool.

view.description: Required heatmap image view. Use "classic" for the sector tile map or "bubble" for the bubble stock heatmap.

universe.description: Optional stock universe. Use "us" for US top stocks or "global" for global top stocks. Defaults to "us".

metric.description: Optional heatmap sizing metric: "marketCap", "volume", or "turnover". Defaults to "marketCap".

timeframe.description: Optional performance timeframe: "1H", "4H", "1D", "1W", "1M", or "1Y". Defaults to "1D".

category.description: Optional sector/category name or slug, such as "Financial Services" or "communication-services". When supplied, the image includes only that category.

response_format.description: Optional output format. Use "json" when a client needs machine-parseable text blocks, especially for Claude artifacts.
